class_predicates.AT_OR_BEFORE_LOOKBACK_PAIR_V2: A qualifying observation exists at observation_time and at least one exists at or before observation_time - lookback_span.
class_predicates.COMPONENT_CONJUNCTION_V2: Every named component owner is independently evaluable under its own predicate. The composite inherits their predicates and invents no window of its own.
class_predicates.CONTIGUOUS_SESSION_CLOSES_V2: minimum_contiguous_count consecutive canonical sessions ending at observation_time each carry a qualifying observation with no gap, and every one of them is strictly positive.
class_predicates.CURRENT_VECTOR_ONLY_V2: Every named current input is present at this decision with available_at <= decision_time. No history window applies at this owner.
class_predicates.DETERMINISTIC_INIT_SMOOTHING_V2: The upstream component is evaluable. A missing previous smoothed score is deterministically initialized by the owner itself and is recorded, never treated as missing evidence.
class_predicates.DUAL_WINDOW_GROWTH_ZSCORE_V2: minimum_count common observations exist, enough for two equal growth windows plus the prior growth history the z-score needs, and both growth z-scores are defined.
class_predicates.EXACT_LOOKBACK_PAIR_V2: A qualifying observation exists at observation_time and at exactly observation_time - lookback_periods sessions.
class_predicates.PRIOR_WINDOW_MIN_COUNT_ELAPSED_V2: At least minimum_prior_count qualifying observations of the required series fall inside the half-open elapsed window [observation_time - window_span, observation_time), and the current observation_time itself carries a qualifying observation. The window span alone never implies completeness.
class_predicates.PRIOR_WINDOW_MIN_COUNT_OBSERVATIONS_V2: At least minimum_prior_count qualifying observations of the required series precede observation_time on the owner's acquisition grid, and the current observation_time carries one. The owner counts observations, not elapsed days, and supplies no cadence of its own.
class_predicates.PUBLICATION_DAY_COUNT_V2: minimum_count complete fund-universe publication days fall inside the trailing publication-calendar window, and the current point-in-time AUM observation is present.
class_predicates.TRAILING_WINDOW_AT_LEAST_ONE_V2: At least one qualifying observation falls inside the half-open trailing window (observation_time - window_span, observation_time].
class_predicates.WEEKLY_SESSION_COUNT_V2: minimum_count qualifying weekly-session observations fall inside the trailing weekly window ending at observation_time.

observation_status_rule: An observed interval carrying zero events is a scientific observation, not a missing feed, and an unavailable, late or invalid interval is adverse evidence that the history is incomplete -- never a zero and never an omission. V2 reuses the certified V1 feed-status vocabulary verbatim rather than authoring a second one.
owner_symbol_resolution_rule: Every owner string V2 freezes is imported and resolved on every build. The certified parent's feature_input_coverage child validated only that its owner string was a non-empty str, and two of its declared feature owners -- btc_predictor.features.positioning.funding_features and btc_predictor.features.positioning.open_interest_growth_features -- do not exist. Their real owners are the *_health functions the parent's own warmup_history child already names, so no science is affected: the parent measured the right predicate under a wrong label. V2 therefore records both the parent-declared string, for exact lineage, and the resolved symbol it verifies, and refuses to build if a resolved symbol disappears. The correction lives in this new V2 child; the certified V1 child is not edited, because editing it would move the immutable parent hash.

canonical_bar_derivation_cutoff.replay_requirement: Daily and weekly canonical bars are derived from 1h source bars and a bar is emitted only when every constituent hour is present, so a bar's very existence is point-in-time evidence. Every V2 source observation on a derived session therefore carries the constituent source-record references that produced it, and the manifest resolves them; a bar without its constituents is not replayable evidence.
canonical_bar_derivation_cutoff.search_evidence: The canonical session owner defines the weekly boundary as Monday 00:00 UTC and the daily boundary as 00:00 UTC.

market_holidays.replay_requirement: The ETF publication window is walked backwards over weekdays that are not in the supplied holiday set, so window membership is a function of that set. With the default empty set a market holiday is indistinguishable from a missing publication. A V2 owner-history manifest for ETF_NORM_5D, ETF_NORM_20D and FLOW_ACCEL therefore carries the exact ordered publication observations it selected, so membership is evidence rather than a recomputation.
market_holidays.search_evidence: No holiday calendar source family exists in the certified parent's PRICE_INPUT_SOURCES or NON_PRICE_INPUT_SOURCES, and no warmup row names one.

same_timestamp_revision_resolution.default: the owners aggregate every row sharing an observation_time rather than resolving a revision
same_timestamp_revision_resolution.replay_requirement: The certified parent freezes APPEND_A_NEW_REVISION_ROW_NEVER_OVERWRITE and REFUSE_A_SECOND_OBSERVATION_FOR_ONE_SOURCE_KEY_AT_ONE_SLOT, but only the ETF owner resolves revisions; the positioning owners sum or average rows that share a timestamp. V2 does not change any owner. It records the exact revision selected per observation_time in the owner-history manifest and refuses two distinct records claiming one revision, so a restatement is visible evidence instead of a silent blend.
same_timestamp_revision_resolution.search_evidence: Revision resolution appears in exactly one feature owner module.
